Jonathan Lewis Executive Director Jonathan Lewis As Executive Director, Jonathan Lewis leads NTEC’s full-time staff and works with the Board of Directors, city leaders and others to achieve The Center’s mission of expanding and diversifying Frisco’s economic base by helping high-potential startups grow into significant contributors to the city’s business community. In the past twenty years, Lewis has led three companies from inception/early-stage; each achieving $100M to well over $1B in revenues. His industry operating experience is broad-based and includes technology, renewable energy, global manufacturing
His industry operating experience is broad-based and includes technology, renewable energy, global manufacturing and related services, and facilities management.
Jonathan has structured and led financing transactions in the public markets, venture capital, and private equity for companies at nearly all stages of development.

He served as CEO of YLG Holdings, Inc., a national leader in the landscape industry; Managing Director of WTCG, a wind energy technology development company; and was the executive leader for the LeBlanc Group, a billion dollar diversified technology telecommunications/broadcast equipment company.
He has also served as presidential campaign Regional Finance Director, Chairman of the Government Affairs Committee, and on the Board of the European/International Energy Trade Association.
Lewis received his graduate education in economics at the University of Delaware, Newark and pursued his undergraduate studies at the University of Nebraska, Lincoln.

He then became Vice President of Technology for a rapidly growing commercial services business that became one of the nation’s largest companies in its sector, and he later broadened his focus to include facilities management for a property management and investment firm.
